name: Last Chance for Gas, AKA Tricky Start

waypoints.name: Shuksan Crag Pullout
waypoints.note: Roadside crag on the left side of unpaved Hannegan Pass Road, about 2 minutes' drive from Mt. Baker Highway (SR-542) near milepost 46. Bolts noted as old/rusty as of last report.
waypoints.directions: From Bellingham, drive the Mt. Baker Highway (SR 542) east through Glacier and continue about 13.3 miles to an unpaved turn on the left, Hannegan Pass Road (FS Road 32), just before the highway crosses the Nooksack River near milepost 46. A couple of minutes up Hannegan Pass Road there is a pullout at roughly 1,000 feet, and the crag is the obvious cliff on the left a few feet from the road. Parking and climbing are effectively the same spot, so expect to be rigging beside passing traffic. The rock season is spring to autumn while the road is open.

waypoints.name: Shuksan Crag topout
waypoints.note: these routes are literally roadside, directly beside the Hannegan Pass Road pullout; trailhead, base, and topout are effectively the same point.
